allocation_rule: Four exclusive lanes run independently against one frozen Shared/App contract snapshot. HQ fixes ownership boundaries; each Worker creates its own next lane-local Macro Wave from current gaps and PARITY needs.
lane_execution_rules: At each user '次', the Worker reads its current branch/status/PARITY and chooses the highest-value lane-local work itself.
The Worker defines a 25-40 minute-equivalent goal/rationale/done_when and executes it in the same response; planning alone is not a completed wave.
Old M01-M04 bundle IDs are historical bootstrap records only and are not a finite task source.
No preloaded task, no HQ replenishment, no READY queue item and another Worker being unfinished are all invalid stop reasons.
If one area is externally blocked, the Worker must continue another meaningful lane-local implementation, hardening or evidence-preparation area when one exists.
Worker-to-Worker code dependencies are deferred to HQ late integration. A Worker must not modify another lane to make its own work pass.

The Worker may stop only for a genuine external/human gate after all meaningful lane-local preparation is exhausted, a required frozen Shared/App contract change, an ownership boundary, or unsafe/impossible operation.
integration_rules: HQ does not merge after every self-planned Macro Wave.
HQ integrates when a coherent checkpoint has integration value or a cross-lane/contract gate requires it.
HQ performs semantic merge, cross-lane compile, device/real-audio validation and PARITY judgment.
After integration HQ updates canonical contracts/status/PARITY; HQ does not author the next normal lane-local backlog.
